title: UPPSC GIC Lecturer Result 2026 – Updated
postName: Lecturer (M/F) Government Inter College Exam – 2025 (Advt. A-6/E-1/2025)
vacancyDetails: 1518 posts – Lecturer Male 777, Female 694, Visually Handicapped/Samekit Vishesh Madhyamik 45, Jail Training School 2. Prelims result released subject-wise for mains shortlist.
qualification: Post Graduate degree in relevant subject with B.Ed. / as per UPPSC GIC Lecturer rules
ageLimit: 21 to 40 years as on 01 July 2025 (relaxations as per UP Govt rules)
applicationFee: As per UPPSC online application fee rules (category-wise)
documentsRequired: Educational certificates, B.Ed., category certificate, domicile, photo ID, application printout
howToApply:
1. Visit https://uppsc.up.nic.in
2. Open the subject-wise GIC Lecturer Prelims result PDF under Results

shortDescription: UPPSC has released updated GIC Lecturer Prelims results 2026 subject-wise. Candidates qualified for mains in Chemistry, Maths, English, History, Sociology, Geography, Economics, Civics, Physics and more.
content:
The Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) has announced the GIC Lecturer Prelims Result 2026 for Advt. No. A-6/E-1/2025.

Results have been released in phases for subjects including Chemistry, Mathematics, English, History, Economics, Civics, Physics, Sociology and Geography. Updated/revised results for some subjects (e.g. Sociology, Geography) have also been published.

Subject-wise qualified (approx.)

  • Chemistry – 2395 | Maths – 853 | English – 2571 | History – 1586
  • Sociology – 806 | Geography – 1927 | Economics – 924 | Civics – 2323 | Physics – 1575

These candidates will be called for the Mains examination. Mains application process will start after remaining subject results are complete. Download PDFs only from uppsc.up.nic.in.
